summary: Mountain lookout cabin north of the Fraser River near Prince George; a trail history dates the lookout to 1929 and sources say it was renovated in 2024.

access.note: Reached via the Giscome-Upper Fraser Highway and the Sinclair/Longworth Road. The trail guide links to a reservation page for the lookout. No water near the cabin in summer.

visit.trail_note: Moderate to steep trail to a ridge above the tree line, then a short walk of about 750 m to the lookout. Harsh weather and avalanche terrain near the lookout.

events.note: Trail history says a lookout was opened in 1929, after severe 1927 forest fires. The source says 'opened', not built.
Trail guide and trail history say the cabin was completely renovated in summer 2024. A supplier provided trusses for the restoration in June 2024.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The trail guide gives the lookout at 1780 m (5935 ft), but 1780 m is 5,840 ft and 5,935 ft is about 1,809 m, so the two figures disagree. The story keeps the guide metre figure and gives the feet converted from it (5,840 ft). The guide feet figure is not used. The editor may want to check the true elevation against another source.

The trail history and the trail guide both say 'completely renovated' in summer 2024. The Winton note calls the June 2024 work a restoration. The story uses renovated and restoration. The operator's own page (pgbrs.org) says 'completely rebuilt in 2024-25', but it returned HTTP 403 and is not used.

notes_for_editor: The brief gives kind 'ground' and access 'unknown'. The trail guide describes a reservable cabin, so access is set to restricted. The operator page (pgbrs.org/longworth-lookout/) returned HTTP 403, so the operator's 'rebuilt in 2024-25' wording is not evidence here. The search snippets from the operator and a Facebook post say 'rebuilt', which conflicts with 'renovated' in two sources; the editor may want to check the operator page directly. The 1929 date rests on one hiking-blog history. Its sentence 'This building still exists four miles (6.4 km) away' is ambiguous; the story reads it as the lookout still standing on the summit. The sitesandtrailsbc REC169514 page returned no text. The Winton page is a contractor's project note.
